subject: [COMPANY] VLM workflows
text:
Hi [NAME], 

 Great to follow [COMPANY]'s work across CV and vision-language workflows.  

At Encord we work with teams building large-scale computer vision systems where the core challenge is managing and operationalizing the data layer behind production AI.  

 We're seeing many teams find that once models reach production, data quality and evaluation become constraints than model development itself. 

 Happy to find time over the coming weeks to provide additional context. How is the week of June 22 looking on your end?

subject: Data annotation tooling build vs buy // learnings DoorDash & eBay
text:
Hi [NAME],

Understand our teams have been speaking recently regarding your data
annotation infrastructure.

I wanted to reach out as I believe the team is looking into an in-house
build - know customisability is a key reason teams choose to explore this -
& we've recently invested significantly in supporting custom layouts
out-of-the-box with no extra engineering time.

We have lots of experience helping teams through the build vs buy
conversations, & think it would be useful to share some pitfalls / costs
that we have come across in the market.

Would you have 20 mins this / next week briefly on this?

subject: Autonomy/Intelligence stack for Traystar <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],
Congrats on the raise. I lead GTM efforts for the Physical AI segment at
Encord, previously having invested as a VC in the space for a number of
years.

I imagine you're early in building the team and underground systems, but
there are a number of visual understanding and intelligence use cases that
I expect you'll be training models against.  We're already working with
some of the top builders in robotics, AVs, drones, and other forms of
embodied intelligence to help develop their data pipelines against model
training.  1X, Bedrock Robotics, Scout AI, Boston Dynamics, etc all chose
to work with Encord as we have the most sophisticated Physical AI suite and
can help automate a large portion of the work that slows researchers down.

Time for a quick call in the next week or two?  Even if too early, it would
be good to give you a sense of when to start prioritizing the annotation
process in your development stack.

Let me know and I can share a few times.

subject: Data management for complex terrain
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw the recent announcement & the shift you're experiencing from development to commercial deployment - wanted to reach out as we've been working with a few teams scaling perception systems for autonomous navigation in complex terrain. 

We're mostly assisting with improving model quality / delivery speed while keeping development costs low as they scale through better end-to-end data mgmt and by allowing them to curate/annotate high resolution videos natively. 

Not sure how familiar you are with Encord - data development platform for computer vision and multimodal AI teams, ~5 years old, 70+ people, $110M raised. 

I'd love to get your candid feedback on what we've built. Let me know if you're open for a quick chat Tuesday to Friday next week?
